entities.summary: Mayumi Inaba  was a Japanese writer and poet. She won the Tanizaki Prize in 2011 for her memoir To the Peninsula (半島へ). Her short story Asa ga nido kuru  was translated into English by Lawrence Rogers for the collection Tokyo Stories: A Literary Stroll.
